analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Oct 30th at US Close
key_insights: US markets recovered partially into the close on Oct 30 but still finished significantly lower. Fundamental managers trimmed losses, Quants slipped slightly further, and Multi-Strats finished flat.
Global Fundamental L/S managers were down 0.85% (-1.3 SD move) at the close, driven mainly by beta and Info Tech. They are down 3.3% MTD and up 9.3% YTD.
TMT-focused funds were down 3.1% (-2.2 SD), down 11.9% MTD, with YTD gains cut to +5.7%.

Global Systematic L/S managers were down 0.7% (-1.9 SD) with losses in all regions, led by Asia and Europe. Momentum, crowding and short-term signals were the main drags. They are down 3.7% MTD, the first negative month of the year, and still up 16% YTD.
Multi-Strats (equity portfolio, 4.5x leverage, no fees) finished flat on the day and are down 0.9% MTD.

At noon ET the selloff was broader and led by Tech, with the NDX down more than 3%. Momentum and growth factors underperformed. Fundamental L/S was then estimated down 1.2% and TMT funds down 3.8%, so the close was a partial recovery.
risk_factors: Growth and momentum factor drawdowns, with NDX down more than 3% at noon ET, hit TMT-heavy and high-beta fundamental books hardest.
Crowding and momentum signals drove systematic losses, so further unwinds could extend them.
vol_and_positioning: Global Fundamental L/S managers' daily move at the close was -1.3 SD. TMT-focused funds' was -2.2 SD, US-focused funds' -1.4 SD and Europe-focused funds' -1.0 SD.
Systematic L/S managers' daily move was -1.9 SD, with momentum, crowding and short-term signals as the main drags. Their MTD loss is the first negative month of the year.
Fundamental L/S losses were driven primarily by beta and Info Tech exposure.
Asia-focused funds were down 1.2% (-1 SD) at noon ET and down 9.5% MTD, still up 14% YTD.
